name: Keystone / patch panel insert
description: Small inserts for the label window on a keystone jack or a patch panel port. Window sizes differ by brand: measure yours and set the size. Cut on the thin outline.

fields.label: Names, one per line
fields.example:
SW1 PORT 1
SW1 PORT 2
NAS
DESK
fields.hint: Each name gets its own label piece

fields.label: Window width (mm)
fields.hint: Measure the label window on the jack/panel

fields.label: Window height (mm)
fields.hint: Measure the label window on the jack/panel

fields.label: Copies of each
fields.hint: 2 = one for each end of the cable
